profile.headline: Software Developer @ IBM
profile.summary: Software developer with experience creating accessible, research-driven digital experiences for enterprise, nonprofit, and higher education organizations. Skilled in interaction design, automation, quality and test engineering, and translating complex workflows into intuitive user interfaces.

positions.title: Design and Implementation Fellow
positions.description: Partnered with the Kelp Forest Foundation to increase digital engagement through website redesign. Developed website architecture and interactive experiences tailored to a diverse audience to foster support for climate solution.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
CIPHER Lab IT Application Support Team (AST)

Develop a cybersecurity asset management platform to support IT services and enforce software security standards within the cybersecurity lab. Modernize CI/CD deployment processes to support GitLab migration effort and reduce technical debt.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Express.js · TypeScript · Material-UI · Node.js · Git · MongoDB

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Design responsive websites for university research labs to showcase research to mobile audiences and generate interest in novel architectures and sustainable computing systems. Develop reusable UI components to improve design consistency and streamline site maintenance.

positions.title: Technical Content Design Intern
positions.description:
Conduct user research (user interviews, content audit, data analysis, and ethnographic field studies) to inform the modernization of a legacy content ecosystem serving 500+ external clients. Translate research insights into UX recommendations that strengthen relationship between product, documentation, and people and reduce friction in content development workflows.

Extreme Blue Technical Leadership Program

Develop tutorial documentation and educational media for the HElayers SDK to make fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) more accessible to software developers and promote end-to-end data privacy. Advocate for expanded internal FHE education by developing and presenting an executive pitch to leadership.
positions.insights: Skills: Darwin Information Typing Architecture (DITA) · Google Analytics · Python

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
Cooperative Education Program, CIPHER Lab IT Application Support Team (AST)

Design and develop internal web applications using Agile methodologies to improve IT services for 350+ lab employees, including asset management systems, a virtual machine deployment application, and a project tracking data visualization tool.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Git · Material-UI · D3.js · Express.js · MongoDB · Node.js

positions.title: Online Editor
positions.description: Manage social media channels and WordPress site for college newspaper, reaching 9k+ students and alumni through tailored digital content. Develop and optimize content strategy, design, and distribution to increase audience engagement and deliver timely coverage of university-wide events.

positions.title: Assistant Online Editor
positions.description:
• Assist Online Editor with online publishing and social media management duties
• Contribute AP style articles to college newspaper

positions.title: Contributing Writer
positions.description: Contribute AP style articles and self-illustrated comic strips to college newspaper weekly

positions.title: User Experience Design Intern
positions.description: Lead redesign of web experiences across 6 public-facing university websites serving 90k+ users, using end-to-end UX processes to balance student needs with organizational goals. Facilitate weekly design critiques and showcases to strengthen collaboration and improve design outcomes.

company.name: Georgia Tech Office of Information Technology

certifications.name: Ansible for IBM Z & LinuxONE Foundations
certifications.title: Ansible for IBM Z & LinuxONE Foundations

honors.title: Georgia Tech Grace Hopper Celebration Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: Selected to represent the Georgia Tech College of Computing for the 2023 Grace Hopper Celebration
honors.issuer: Issued by Georgia Institute of Technology · Sep 2023

honors.title: Second Place Best Entertainment Feature, GCPA
honors.description: Won award for digitally drawn comic strip published weekly (Sep 2020-Dec 2021) in the Technique
honors.issuer: Issued by Georgia College Press Association · Feb 2022

volunteerExperiences.description:
• User Experience Designer with Epic Intentions, a pro bono consulting organization
• Partnered with Grant Park Conservancy (1M visitors yearly) to design guided tour mobile app to raise park engagement
• Led design team through ideation, research, and design handoff of an app mockup and style guide

• Identify and establish relationships with 20+ local nonprofits to pinpoint areas of technological need
• Draft project proposals for nonprofits and pitch to executive review board
